scope: F2 SDK executor handoff; implementation and unit evidence, not F3 acceptance

hello.requirements: Only the main broker can make ready true after actual native sender/document/permission/grant validation. Registry metadata and page payloads grant nothing. SDK validates version and registered method subset.

request.brokerNormalization: decodeValue(payload.argsWire) -> validateSdkRequest({requestId,method,args,deadlineAt}) -> normalizeMethod -> unique authority transaction admission
request.businessData: Driver successful value always resides in data even if it contains PageBrigeCode, ok, error, message or nested undefined. No field guessing. Legacy explicit failure callback bodies are processed only by ChromeBridgeOperationCompleted, not inferred from driver successful values.
request.settlement: ACK never settles original Promise as success. A missing final valueWire is E_EFFECT_UNKNOWN in the fixed native transport. No write retry/replay in SDK or relay. Broker owns request digest, durable/unknown effects, result and delivery journal.

APPSTORAGE_SETITEM.value: String conversion by normalizeMethod; no caller namespace

CHROME_LOCAL_GET.key: safe string or null; null returns authorized namespace value array

CHROME_LOCAL_SET.values: safe key/value plain object, typed values

NETWORK_INFO_GET.ip: optional string; disabled unless explicitly enabled and authorized

httpConfig.params: primitive or primitive arrays; null/undefined omitted

publicInterfaces.service: createSdkService({network,notifications,storage,device}).execute(method,args,context) -> legacyResult of successful value; typed driver errors reject
publicInterfaces.bridge: createSdkBridge({transport,...}); transport.hello({sdkVersion}) and transport.request({requestId,method,args,deadlineAt}) are internal typed interfaces. Fixed window transport converts internal args to argsWire.
publicInterfaces.page: installPageSdk({global?,transport?}) -> OpenDeskSDK; OpenDeskSDK.ready() -> Promise<actual native Hello>; OpenDeskSDK.call(method,args); OpenDeskSDK.service.storage.get(null); global old axiosx/AppStorage/AppLocal/createNotify/serverUtils/sleep/ChromeBridgeEvents/ChromeBridgeOperationCompleted/callChromeBridgeInterface names
publicInterfaces.storage: storage.executeSdk(method,args,context) provided by shared storage writer; durable AppStorage vs chrome.storage.session AppLocal; main effects/result must commit in same transaction
publicInterfaces.device: device.getAppId(context) atomic shared-storage get-or-create, commit awaited, no separate storage

driverAuthorization.hook: authorize(request, context): Promise<void>; usually main adapter delegates to context.authorize(request)
driverAuthorization.transactions: Drivers do not own admission/journal/database. The main router supplies final authorizeInTransaction and commits effects/result via sole shared storage. Native pre/post validation is separate from final transactional revalidation.
driverAuthorization.nativeReceipt: After actual HTTP projection and before post authorization, await context.recordNativeReceipt(projection). This stores the native observation only; broker recordEffect retains final normalized driver result ownership.

budgets.rule: network hard-clamps to 15s and any earlier context deadline. Client timeout and config cannot extend backend budget.

resources.fingerprint: E_RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE stage lookup; no fallback or business/native activation
